title: Library-Hold Expiry Risk
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:progress source=library hold_expiry_epoch=*
| eval hours_left=round((hold_expiry_epoch-now())/3600,1)
| where status!="finished"
| sort hours_left
description: Lists unfinished library books or holds that are nearing their expiry or return deadline.
value: Holds expire silently and returned books stop progress; this query protects reading plans from administrative drift.
implementation: Capture library source and hold expiry timestamps in `reading:progress`; sort unfinished books by time left.
visualization: Table of unfinished library titles with hours remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which library books are about to run out of time before you finish them.
